_comment: Blast-radius config. Programmatic core only. Edit `seam` and `dynamicEdges` by hand; agents will later append discovered blind-spot edges to `dynamicEdges`.

seam._comment: The cross-language wire contract. A change to ANY of these can break consumers in OTHER languages that no single-language graph can see. Each consumer carries a machine-resolvable locator (files + anchor regex) so the dossier builder can slice the actual code on the far side of the seam.

consumers.label: go:internal/manifest — parses GET /v1/capabilities to build the bp CLI

guards: api/test/barkpark_web/contract/query_test.exs (contract test — /v1/data/query response shape, envelope keys, etag/304, filter forms)
api/test/barkpark_web/contract/mutate_test.exs (contract test — /v1/data/mutate status codes, atomic batch, ifRevisionID/If-Match, error envelope)
api/test/barkpark_web/contract/schema_envelope_test.exs (contract test — field-type wire shape: required?, array `of`, reference `to`, listPreview, schemaHash)
api/test/barkpark_web/contract/webhooks_test.exs (contract test — /v1/webhooks CRUD status codes + envelope, admin auth, validation)
api/test/barkpark_web/contract/listen_test.exs (contract test — SSE mutation frame + syncTags shape consumed by nextjs-query revalidation)

dynamicEdges._comment: Edges no static graph can see — string-keyed dispatch, behaviours, config wiring. Promoted from agent findings so the hook catches them for free on the next run. Each: when `from` glob changes, the listed `affects` are at risk.
